series.title: Love Is A Dangerous Game
series.synopsis: Olivia is dragged by her husband Ryan to a couples-swapping getaway—only to be paired with Jake, the husband of her closest friend Mia. Jake is magnetic, unreadable, relentless—nothing like the dull, clueless husband Mia always described. And he won't stop closing in. As both men begin fighting for Olivia's attention, and Mia's jealousy cracks in her perfect act, Olivia must uncover the real truth behind the partner-swapping party before it's too late.

series.title: Deny Me, Dragon King
series.synopsis: Human Lyra stumbles on Dragon King Kael and shares a passionate night. Tricked by a fake prophecy, he casts her out—only for Lyra to bear his half-dragon daughter Amber. Years later, she returns seeking a healer to save her sick child. Old sparks reignite, jealous rivals plot, and hidden blood ties surface as they fight for their family and broken love.

series.title: Tempest：The Last Mecha
series.synopsis: Broken by his parents' deaths, Colt Thorne, the Mech King, hides as a lowly janitor after being saved by Freya. But when Freya, the woman he secretly loves, is betrayed and forced into a lethal mech duel, Colt must unleash his hidden identity. Unlocking his legendary 100% Neural Sync, he commands The Tempest to crush his enemies and save the world from an extinction-level alien swarm!

series.title: My Billionaire Patient Is My Baby Daddy
series.originalTitle: My Billionaire Patient Is My Baby Daddy
series.synopsis: Ella is tricked by her divorce-seeking husband Arthur into sleeping with a stranger on their wedding night, and later gives birth to twins, with one dumped on a hospital bench by him. Fisher, the stranger and a billionaire, finds him and raises him. Years later, Ella serves as Fisher's physical therapist in his estate, looking for her missing son. As the truth unravels, Ella finds her other son, and heals both him and Fisher. The family of four is eventually reunited.

series.title: No More Blood For My Vampire First Love
series.originalTitle: No More Blood For My Vampire First Love
series.synopsis: She gave him her heart, only to be used as a pawn to win her cruel stepsister. Shattered, the gifted Keeper Allie walks away—straight into the devotion of an ancient Original who has waited two centuries for her.  Watching her reign alongside a far superior man, her ex falls to his knees begging for a second chance. Too late. She destroys her enemies and chooses true love, leaving the boy who broke her choking on regret.

series.title: Betrothed to a Beggar, Crowned a Dragon Queen
series.originalTitle: Betrothed to a Beggar Crowned a Dragon Queen
series.synopsis: Betrayed by her fiancé and mocked by her family, Lyra chooses a penniless, hornless stranger as her destined mate. But "Ethan" is actually Aurelian, the legendary Dragon God in disguise. As jealous Astrid turns to forbidden magic and deadly enemies close in, Lyra must fight for love, dignity, and her true power—until the discarded daughter rises from humiliation to become the Dragon Queen.

series.title: My Trash Pup Is Fenrir
series.synopsis: Rayne, a mysterious beast tamer raised in the mountains, returns to civilization with his scruffy stray dog, Max. When he reunites with Elena—the girl he promised to marry fourteen years ago—he discovers she is now engaged to a powerful nobleman. As the Barbarians threaten her city, Rayne must uncover his true identity, awaken Max’s hidden power, and protect the woman he never stopped loving.

series.title: My Weak Little Dog Is a Legendary Sky Lion
series.originalTitle: My Weak Little Dog Is a Legendary Sky Lion
series.synopsis: Betrayed by her lover Corrin and best friend Ophelia, Amber was stripped of her bloodline and brutally murdered. Reborn on the day she chose her bonded beast, she refuses the powerful Corrin and instead bonds with a lowly white dog Aerion, who tried to save her in the past life and later reveals his true form—the legendary Sky Lion. Just as Amber begins her revenge against the betrayers, a darker conspiracy unfolds, revealing the ultimate mastermind pulling the strings.

series.title: Wet Hot Summer with the Boy I Lost
series.originalTitle: Wet Hot Summer with the Boy I Lost
series.synopsis: On the last day of school, Skye bets her biggest bully she'll lose her virginity to the hottest guy, Luke, over the summer. But shy Skye has never even been kissed. When her irresistibly hot neighbor Grayson offers to teach her how to win Luke over, sparks fly between them instead. Soon, Skye realizes the one guy she swore she'd never want is the one she can't resist.

series.title: Forbidden Fling With My Bestie's Dad
series.originalTitle: Forbidden Fling With My Bestie s Dad
series.synopsis: After catching her fiancé cheating on the flight to her best friend's tropical wedding, grad student Mia drunkenly hooks up with Damien, a mysterious silver-fox billionaire, only to discover he's the bride's father. Forced to hide their forbidden attraction throughout a chaotic wedding weekend, they face jealous exes, secret encounters, and vengeful sabotage that could destroy the ceremony.

series.title: He Broke the Heart That Saved Him
series.originalTitle: He Broke the Heart That Saved Him
series.synopsis: Mia sacrifices everything for her dying lover Vance, never knowing he is Cloud City's greatest heir. To return the future to him, Mia walks away resolutely without telling him she's pregnant. Years later, their child's tragic fate crosses their paths again. Yet vicious lies turn him against her, driving their boy to his death. Since then, Mia has lived in the pain of losing her son, while Vance, upon discovering the truth, will be left to bear the crushing weight of regret.

series.title: Kneel Before The Dragon Queen
series.synopsis:
After seven years in hiding, Dragon Queen Veya 
returns disguised as a humble healer, only to be 
betrayed and humiliated by the man she once loved. 
When she enters a marriage of convenience with 
powerful Duke Kael Frostwing, her enemies mistake 
her for a powerless commoner—until Veya reveals 
her true identity and reclaims her throne.

series.title: Poisoned by His Love
series.synopsis: On her half-sister Victoria's wedding day, 25-year-old nurse Lily Watson is forced into a deadly bargain. Victoria is set to marry Dominic Castellano, a ruthless mafia king rumored to have killed his last wife. But when Victoria flees, Dominic's hitmen threaten Lily's family. To protect them, Lily takes Victoria's place at the altar and becomes the bride of a man she fears may be a killer.

series.title: Shifter Academy: Taming Three Wild Mates
series.originalTitle: Shifter Academy Taming Three Wild Mates
series.synopsis:
What could possibly go wrong when a human girl spends mating season at a school full of apex predators? Everything.
Ivy only wanted to finish her education. Instead, her scholarship to Shifter Academy comes with a catch: she's the fated mate of not one, not two, but three of the strongest shifters on campus: Ronan, Leon and Talon.
Three alphas. One impossible choice. Her heart has chosen. It's love at first slap.

series.title: Silence! Boss Lady Speaks
series.synopsis: Eleanor, a reclusive heiress returning from Africa, is mistaken for a penniless charity worker and publicly humiliated by her ex and his family. But when a mysterious CEO, Sebastian, sees something rare in her and proposes marriage, their union sends shockwaves through high society. As her enemies push too far, Eleanor fights back—revealing her true identity as Thunder Lady, the secret CEO of the world’s most powerful investment syndicate.

series.title: Revenge Puck
series.synopsis: Lucy has just been cheated on and dumped by her ex-boyfriend and hockey star Adam. She makes a deal to fake date his biggest hockey rival, Blake, to throw off his game until the end of the playoffs.

series.title: My Brother's Wrath Awaits
series.synopsis: After surviving an abusive mafia father, Aurora spends her life calming her volatile brother Lucian, now the city's most feared mafia boss, who violently punishes anyone who disturbs her peace. When Lucian's iancée mistakes Aurora for a maid and tortures her, Lucian is manipulated into hurting Aurora. As Aurora disappearsinto the underground black market, Lucian uncovers the devastating truth and unleashes his wrath on everyone responsible - even himself.

series.title: El Señor Supremo
series.synopsis: Theo Larsen, alias el Señor Supremo, comanda un Ejército de Lobos de un millón de soldados. Ocultando su identidad, se casa con Sarah Welsh, la hija de la próspera familia Welsh, asegurando el futuro del Grupo Glory antes de ascender a la cima de su vida.

series.title: Fortunas Reveladas: Mi Esposo Es Poderoso
series.originalTitle: Fortunes Unveiled My Husband Is a Big Shot
series.synopsis: En el primer día del Año Nuevo Chino, Jay Wade visita a la familia de su esposa, solo para ser maltratado con desprecio. Poco saben que Jay en realidad es el presidente de Corporación Win, una de las diez empresas principales del mundo.

series.title: Un Aliento Lejos de la Eternidad
series.synopsis: Hace cinco años, Callista Summers rescató a Jeremiah Fuller cuando estaba drogado. A continuación, ella siguió su carrera en el extranjero, impulsada por sus dudas iniciales, como ama de llaves. Con el tiempo, Callista se convirtió en una diseñadora y en una madre devota de su hijo, Scotty Fuller. Cuando se entera de la insuficiencia renal de Jeremiah, regresa para donarle su riñón, salvándolo una vez más. Sin embargo, los malentendidos generan animadversión entre ellos.

series.title: Casada con el Hombre de mis Sueños
series.originalTitle: Waking Up Married To My Crush
series.synopsis: Al despertarse, Jimena descubrió que se había casado, y no con otros, sino con Patricio, quien es guapo y rico. Sin embargo, rápidamente descubre que su matrimonio se va viniendo abajo. Un accidente trágico le había dañado el cerebro, dejándola con una amnesia traumática que borró los últimos años de su vida, atrapada a la edad de 21 años. Determinada a no pasar la edad de 25 años siendo una esposa fanática y servil, Jimena decide recuperar su brillo.

series.title: Una Noche Para Siempre
series.synopsis: Luego de pasar una noche con Layla Reed, Miles Zeller toma su collar de copo de nieve y le ordena a sus hombres que la traten como su futura esposa. Sin embargo, su subordinado confunde a Lana Reed con Layla, lo que desencadena una competencia entre la verdadera Layla y la impostora por el título de Señora Zeller.

series.title: De Regreso a los 80
series.synopsis: Julie Stein se despierta de su sueño, esperando que solo será otro día ordinario. Sin embargo, para su sorpresa, se encuentra en los años 80, una era totalmente diferente a la que pertenece. No solo era una hija desheredada de una familia adinerada a la que no tiene conexiones sanguíneas, sino que también se supone que debe casarse con un hombre mayor con dos hijos, en lugar de la hija biológica de la familia.

series.title: El Regreso de la Reina Dominante
series.synopsis: Layla Moore, antigua segunda al mando del Palacio Seradel, se mudó a Redville con su hija, Clara Moore. Hace seis meses, Clara se casó con Harry Chase, que la ha sometido a abusos y violencia. Harry no solo es un mal marido, sino que además conspira con un bandido llamado Michael Kane para obtener beneficios personales. Cuando se corre la voz de sus planes, Layla regresa a Seradel, reclamando su trono como reina para salvar a su hija.

series.title: Supremacía sin límite: Ascendiendo por encima de todo
series.synopsis: Maxwell Kane, que una vez fue un gran Señor del Valor, se encuentra ahora luchando contra la pérdida de su memoria, llevando una vida dura trabajando en la construcción. Sin embargo, el destino da un giro inesperado cuando conoce a una mujer llamada Samantha Claude. Ambos se reúnen para hablar del acuerdo matrimonial que tenían antes de la pérdida de memoria de él. Los dos unen sus fuerzas contra sus familias que se oponen, decididos a superar los obstáculos.

series.title: Una Noche Destinada con mi Jefe
series.originalTitle: One Fateful Night with My Boss
series.synopsis: Después de pasar una noche con un hombre por dinero, Anita se despidió de esta fría ciudad y fue al extranjero. Seis años después, regresa con su hijo y se encuentra con el legendario CEO, Tristan, quien resulta ser su nuevo jefe. Antes de que pudiera darse cuenta, su hijo comienza a llamar a este apuesto nuevo jefe: "papá". ¿Podría ser esto el destino?

series.title: Mi Esposo Agente Secreto
series.synopsis: Para escapar de un matrimonio arreglado por motivos políticos, el heredero privilegiado Lucas Walton finge ser gay y se compromete con el nuevo ejecutivo de su empresa, sin saber que su "prometido" es en realidad un agente secreto que esta investigando los negocios corruptos de su familia, lo que lleva a un hilarante choque de secretos, peligro y sentimientos inesperados.

series.title: Mated with My Fiance's Alpha Daddy
series.originalTitle: Mated with My Fiance s Alpha Daddy
series.synopsis:
Jessie finds herself in a perilous situation where she has been drugged and raped, only to be rescued by Alpha Andrew, who discovers they are mates. However, when Andrew attempts to establish a relationship with Jessie, she claims her engagement to another man.
On her wedding with Derek, it turns out Andrew is her fiance's dad....
Where will this "forbidden love" manipulated by fate ultimately lead?

series.title: Senderos de Esperanza: Su Viaje de Regreso a Casa
series.originalTitle: Trails of Hope His Journey Back Home
series.synopsis: Theo Levy perdió contacto con sus padres hace 20 años debido a un accidente automovilístico. Afortunadamente, él fue adoptado por el presidente del Grupo Boyd, quien lo crio hasta convertirlo en el hombre que es hoy. Ahora que finalmente regresa a su ciudad natal, jura encontrar a sus padres biológicos con el colgante que tiene.

series.title: Fortunas Reveladas: Mi Esposo Es Poderoso (Doblado)
series.originalTitle: Fortunes Unveiled My Husband Is a Big Shot DUBBED
series.synopsis: En el primer día del Año Nuevo Chino, Jay Wade visita a la familia de su esposa, solo para ser maltratado con desprecio. Poco saben que Jay en realidad es el presidente de Corporación Win, una de las diez empresas principales del mundo.
